info.name: Cleanora R1-P02 Authentication
info.description:
Canonical R1-P02 Auth API collection with explicit Hosted and Local folders. Every request includes a saved Success example; requests with bodies also include a commented Sample of correct body. Hosted request names identify email flows blocked while Railway SMTP is unavailable. Refresh credentials remain in the cookie jar and secrets remain empty in exported environments.

Local Swagger: http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs
Railway Swagger: https://cleanora-production.up.railway.app/api/v1/docs
